_name: E — full pipeline with the LEARNED face-quality gate
_mechanisms_active: Everything in C (Method 1, face_says_stranger gate, face_veto, ID-switch guard)

evidence gating — a sighting/photo is filed ONLY when a gate-passing face directly confirms the code THIS cycle (or the code was freshly earned from that face). A cached/inherited code with no reconfirming face this cycle keeps its live on-screen label but writes no evidence.
_registration_note: Same registration rule as A/B/C: a visible face is required to mint a new code. This file changes nothing about registration relative to the others — the difference across all 4 ablation configs is entirely about how EXISTING identities are protected from being merged or hijacked.
_verified: Confirmed byte-identical to running with no SMARTDETECT_IDENTITY_CONFIG set at all (scripts/purity_eval.py output diffed, exit 0) — this file exists so the ablation sweep has an explicit 'current behavior' entry rather than relying on an implicit unset-env-var case.
_gate_note: Identical to D_full except the face-quality gate: instead of the fixed 48px/0.60 pair, a 2-layer MLP predicts the discriminative margin (genuine minus best-impostor cosine) and admits above learned_quality_min_margin. Every identity flag is unchanged — this isolates the gate.
_expected: On ChokePoint this should be INDISTINGUISHABLE from D: the fixed gate already admits 2832 of 2833 associated faces and every one has a positive margin, so there is no coverage to recover and no unsafe face to refuse.
